summary.headline: Weekly baseline is a barbell: Monday inventory plus a large Friday long-convexity book with defensive skew
key_points: About 40% of visible future premium is in Monday and about 45% in Friday; the middle of the week is much thinner.
Monday is balanced around 7710-7730 with a 7700-7750 initial decision range.
Tuesday is the clearest early-week defensive bucket, centered on 7715 call supply and 7750 put-heavy protection.
Wednesday is thin and conflicted between a sold 7650-7800 range and probable long-strangle demand.
Thursday has no visible $50k+ prints in the Friday baseline and should be treated as unformed rather than empty positioning.
Friday is the largest risk book. Downside protection is more distributed; upside demand is materially concentrated in one 7715C block.
summary.daily_note: Baseline for the stateful weekly book. Track each expiry against this snapshot: protection added/removed, level state changes, and migration/roll of risk from early-week expiries into Thursday/Friday.

levels.label: WEEKLY 7710-7715 MAIN PIVOT
levels.interpretation: Cross-expiry conflict is concentrated here: Tuesday sells upside around 7715 while Friday contains the dominant 7715C buy block.

levels.label: WEEKLY 7750-7755 UPPER DECISION
levels.interpretation: 7750 is the largest gross-premium strike of the future week; Tuesday and Friday both show defensive put-heavy positioning here.

levels.label: WEEKLY 7700 DOWNSIDE ACTIVATION
levels.interpretation: 7700 has nearly $10m visible gross premium and substantial Friday put demand; acceptance below it activates the next downside route.

levels.label: WEEKLY 7650-7675 CONDITIONAL FLOOR
levels.interpretation: Put selling and spread inventory create conditional downside risk acceptance, but this support is not unconditional.

levels.label: WEEKLY 7615-7625 LOWER DOWNSIDE ZONE
levels.interpretation: This is the next visible lower protection/wing zone if 7650 fails.

levels.label: WEEKLY 7775-7810 UPSIDE TRANSIT
levels.interpretation: Above 7755, the next visible route is 7775 and then 7800-7810.

monetization_zones.description: The weekly baseline is unresolved inside 7700-7755; acceptance outside this band is more informative than raw net premium inside it.
monetization_zones.caveat: Fresh Monday flow can quickly replace the Friday baseline.

monetization_zones.description: Acceptance below 7700 activates a visible downside route through 7675/7650 toward 7625/7615.
monetization_zones.caveat: Sold-put inventory around 7650-7675 is a conditional floor and can become destabilizing if price accepts below it.

monetization_zones.description: Acceptance above 7750-7755 opens the visible upside transit through 7775 into 7800-7810.
monetization_zones.caveat: The Friday upside edge is less robust than downside protection because a large share is concentrated in one 7715C block.

summary.headline: Balanced Monday inventory around 7710-7730; 7700-7750 is the initial decision range

levels.label: MON 7710-7730 PIVOT / INVENTORY
levels.interpretation: Near-spot two-sided premium and opposing spreads make this the main Monday inventory center.

levels.label: MON 7750 UPPER DECISION
levels.interpretation: 7750 carries both put demand and sold-put inventory; interpretation depends on linked structures and new Monday flow.

levels.label: MON 7700 LOWER DECISION
levels.interpretation: 7700 is a high-gross near-spot strike and the lower leg of repeated call-debit-like packages.

structures.interpretation: Equal-size same-time long call / short put is synthetic-long-like. It should not be read as an independent short-put floor without opening/closing confirmation.
Same-time equal-size 7750P buy / 7730P sell is consistent with a downside put debit spread.
Four repeated 100x same-time packages are consistent with 7700/7725 call debit spreads.

monetization_zones.description: Friday baseline does not show a clean directional edge inside 7700-7750.
monetization_zones.caveat: Monday flow can rapidly replace this Friday baseline.

summary.headline: Tuesday is the clearest early-week defensive bucket: 7715 call supply and 7750 put-heavy protection

levels.label: TUE 7750 DEFENSIVE CENTER
levels.interpretation: Largest Tuesday strike; strong put demand plus same-time call selling creates the clearest defensive cluster.

levels.label: TUE 7715 CALL SUPPLY / PIVOT
levels.interpretation: Repeated 7715C sales financed by 7740C buys place the lower spread strike directly around the weekly pivot.

levels.label: TUE 7690 DOWNSIDE PROTECTION
levels.interpretation: Net put buying below the pivot provides the next Tuesday downside protection zone.

structures.interpretation: Four 100x put buys and three 100x call sells at the same strike/time are consistent with a 300x synthetic-short-like package plus extra long put if linked.
Four repeated 100x packages sell 7715C and buy 7740C, consistent with call-credit-like upside supply.

monetization_zones.description: Below/inside 7715-7750 the Tuesday book is defensively skewed; reclaim above the zone would challenge the initial book.

summary.headline: Wednesday is thin and conflicted: a sold 7650-7800 range coexists with probable long-strangle demand

levels.label: WED 7650-7800 SOLD RANGE
levels.interpretation: The clearest four-leg Wednesday package sells the 7650-7800 body, but a separate long-strangle-like package creates a conflicting long-vol signal.

levels.label: WED 7625 LOWER VOL LEG
levels.interpretation: 300x put buying is one half of the likely long-strangle-like package.

levels.label: WED 7760 UPPER VOL LEG
levels.interpretation: 300x call buying is the upper half of the likely long-strangle-like package.

structures.interpretation: Four same-time 200x legs form an iron-condor-like package selling the 7650-7800 body with 7615/7835 wings.
300x 7625P and 300x 7760C were bought one second apart at the same spot, consistent with long-strangle-like demand.

monetization_zones.description: The 200x condor-like package monetizes inside the 7650-7800 body.
monetization_zones.caveat: Separate long-strangle-like demand creates a conflicting volatility view.

summary.headline: No visible $50k+ Thursday trades in the Friday baseline; treat as an unformed book, not zero positioning
Friday is the largest risk book: long convexity with a more persistent downside-protection skew

levels.label: FRI 7715 UPSIDE / VOL CENTER
levels.interpretation: The Friday upside edge is concentrated in a single same-second 7715C buy cluster; leave-cluster-out would materially reduce the call-bias.

levels.label: FRI 7750 DEFENSIVE / UPPER DECISION
levels.interpretation: 7750 is the largest weekly strike and carries a $3.6m single put buy plus broader put demand and call selling.

levels.label: FRI 7700 DOWNSIDE ACTIVATION
levels.interpretation: Heavy and distributed 7700P buying makes this the first downside activation level in the Friday book.

levels.label: FRI 7650-7675 CONDITIONAL FLOOR
levels.interpretation: Put selling and call demand below spot create conditional risk acceptance, but the zone can destabilize if price accepts below it.

levels.label: FRI 7800-7810 UPSIDE TRANSIT
levels.interpretation: This is the next visible upside strike cluster after acceptance above 7750-7755.

structures.interpretation: A same-second 1,523-contract 7715C buy cluster contributes about $6.1m premium and dominates the visible Friday call-buying edge.
600x 7750P buy for about $3.6m is the largest single future-expiry print in the baseline.
A same-second cluster bought 550x 7700P for about $2.21m, adding distributed downside demand below the weekly pivot.
Deep ITM 5000C/10000P prints are treated as parity/box/conversion-like inventory and excluded from directional interpretation.

monetization_zones.description: The Friday body contains paid convexity on both sides; downside demand is more distributed than the upside call block.
monetization_zones.caveat: The upside premium edge is highly concentrated in the 7715C cluster.

scenarios.name: Weekly decision range
scenarios.interpretation: Inside 7700-7755 the baseline remains mixed; Monday inventory and cross-expiry conflict favor waiting for fresh flow.

scenarios.name: Upside realization

triggers.description: Fresh call demand confirms that Friday upside demand is not merely a one-off cluster

scenarios.interpretation: Acceptance above 7750-7755 challenges the Tuesday defensive book and activates the visible 7775 to 7800-7810 route.

scenarios.name: Downside realization

triggers.description: Lose the first downside activation level
Fresh put demand extends the Friday protection build

scenarios.interpretation: Below 7700 the more persistent defensive asymmetry becomes active; failure of 7650-7675 can turn conditional put-risk acceptance into acceleration.

caveats: Complex-order IDs are absent, so same-time equal-size structures remain inferred rather than confirmed.
Repeated identical-parameter prints with unique trade IDs were retained as distinct trades.
Deep ITM parity/box/conversion-like prints were excluded from directional interpretation where identified.
Thursday has no visible $50k+ flow in this Friday baseline; that is not evidence of zero market positioning.
Source timestamp/timezone semantics are inherited from the export and were not reinterpreted.
